description: Get one transfer in this account by its UETR, with every bank report in the full view, or the free tracker's view for a free transfer. When a bank last reported: in the free view, free.last_report_at is the newest bank report time, a time a bank gave (null when no report gives one), while free.last_update_at is only when the newest report was first received; in the full view, each event's reported_at is the bank's own time. free.amount_bank_number and free.value_date_bank_number name which numbered bank (as in free.reports) reported the amount and the value date: they are bank numbers, not counts, and free.reporting_banks is the count. The number of people who follow the transfer's updates comes from get_watcher_count. The demo transfer 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000 works for every key. Each hour (UTC) it is searching, with no bank reports, for its first 10 minutes, then gains a bank report every 10 minutes until it is credited at 50 minutes past the hour. Reading changes nothing.
name: get_transfer

corrections_remaining.description: How many more corrections the account owner can make to the entered amount, currency and payment date now that a bank has reported. Null when no bank has reported, when the API key or connected app is not the account owner's, when the transfer is archived, or when the count could not be read.

value.description: The amount in the supplied currency's major units, not minor units. For example, 129600 USD means USD 129,600.00.

amount.description: The amount this report carried, when it carried one.

bank_processing_status.description: The bank's own processing status, in its words.

bank_reference.description: The bank's reference for the payment.

chips_ssn.description: The CHIPS sequence number the bank reported.

currency.description: The currency the report stated, when it stated one. A report can state a currency with no amount and no fees.

details.description: Every further detail the bank record shows for this report, in the record's order, with the bank's times by stage and then durations last. Kinds: amounts by role, references, banks the report names in the payment's chain, exchange rates, the charge bearer, fee notes, reject or return reasons, messages, event statuses and literal cancellation-request codes. A cancellation request is separate from the transaction outcome. Fees are in fees. A detail that restates the bank reference, the bank's status time or a stored amount is left out. New kinds and values can appear within an API version; skip any you do not recognise.

bank.description: The bank the report ties this detail to: its name, or its BIC when the report gives no name.

code.description: The bank's literal cancellation-request code, separate from the transaction status. It does not establish that money was stopped or returned.

event_number.description: The event inside this report's own list of events that the detail belongs to, as the bank record numbers it. It is not a position in events. Null when the detail belongs to the report as a whole.

anyOf.description: An amount the report states, by its role. The event's own amount is the figure the timeline quotes for the report.

event_type.description: The tracking event type, such as CTPT or CTSU.

message_name.description: The message name, such as pacs.008.001.08.

anyOf.description: The status the report gives one event, with its reason, as the bank stated them.

bank.description: The bank the report ties this detail to: its name, or its BIC when the report gives no name.

event_number.description: The event inside this report's own list of events that the detail belongs to, as the bank record numbers it. It is not a position in events. Null when the detail belongs to the report as a whole.

extended_tracking_status.description: The bank's extended tracking status, in its words.

fees.description: Every fee this report stated, as the bank listed them.

charged_by.description: The bank the report says charged it, if any.

event_number.description: The event inside this report's own list of events that the fee belongs to, as the bank record numbers it; null when the fee belongs to the report as a whole.

label.description: The bank's own name for the fee, if it gave one.

role.description: A stated total, one part of a total, or one bank's charge.

value.description: When currency is supplied, the fee is in that currency's major units, not minor units. A null currency remains unspecified.

observed_at.description: When this report was first received. When received_before_added is true, that time is withheld and observed_at only keeps the report's place among the reports: the time this account added the transfer (one millisecond later for each such report received before it), or, when a bank time from before that add follows the report, just before that bank time.

payment_date.description: The value date this report carried, when it carried one.

received_before_added.description: True when this report was first received before this account added the transfer. Its receipt time is not given; reported_at, the bank's own time, is unchanged.

reported_at.description: When the bank reported this status, if the report carries that time.

reporting_bank.description: The bank that reported. It is not necessarily on the payment's route.

status_code.description: The ISO 20022 status code the bank reported.

events.description: Every bank report, in the full view only, in the stage order of the transfer's timeline, earliest stage first: the last is the latest stage, which may have been received before an earlier stage's report (see observed_at).

amount_bank_number.description: The number of the bank (its reports[].bank_number) that reported the transfer's bank_reported_amount. A bank's number, never a count: reporting_banks is the count.

attention.description: A bank's current report flags an issue: action needed, or waiting at a bank. The code and bank are in the full view.

delay.description: Whole days since any bank last reported, when that is longer than usual.

has_activity.description: True once any bank has reported the transfer.

last_report_at.description: The newest time a bank itself gave for a report in the free view: the latest reports[].reported_at whose time_source is bank_reported. Null when no listed report gives a bank time; a report without one shows when it was first received.

last_update_at.description: When the newest report in the free view was first received, which can be long after the bank's own report time. The newest bank report time is last_report_at.

next_update_at.description: When the free view next refreshes.

name.description: The bank's name, when the directory knows it.

other_banks.description: True when other banks took part; they are named in the full view.

name.description: The bank's name, when the directory knows it.

payment_route.description: The sending and beneficiary banks the reports confirm.

pending_report_at.description: The recorded time of the newer report not yet in the free view, when it has one.

pending_update_at.description: When a newer report becomes visible in the free view.

report_counts.description: Counts of details the full view shows, as the free tracker lists them.

reported_by.description: The same bank numbers as amount_bank_number and value_date_bank_number, kept for existing clients. Each is a bank's number, never a count.

reporting_bank_countries.description: Home countries of the banks that reported. These are not the payment's route.

reports.description: The reports the free view shows, in its order: the report behind the current status first, then newest first by reported_at, with reports that have no time last. At most 50.

value.description: When currency is supplied, the amount is in that currency's major units, not minor units. A null currency remains unspecified.

amount.description: The amount this report carried, when it carried one; the currency is null when the report gave none.

bank_number.description: The reporting bank, numbered within this transfer; its name is in the full view.

details_in_full_view.description: Which details this report holds that the full view shows. Only their presence is in the free view.

payment_date.description: The value date this report carried, when it carried one.

received_before_added.description: True when a first_received report was first received before this account added the transfer.

reported_at.description: The report's time. A first_received time from before this account added the transfer reads as the time the account added it (see received_before_added).

time_source.description: Whether the time is the one the bank gave, or when the report was first received.

total_reports.description: How many reports the free view counts.

value_date_bank_number.description: The number of the bank (its reports[].bank_number) that reported the bank-reported value date. A bank's number, never a count.

free.description: The free tracker's view, in the free view only.

amount.description: The amount entered for the search, as last corrected by the account owner. bank_reported_amount is what a bank reported.

value.description: The amount in the supplied currency's major units, not minor units. For example, 129600 USD means USD 129,600.00.

archived.description: True when the transfer is archived.

value.description: The amount in the supplied currency's major units, not minor units. For example, 129600 USD means USD 129,600.00.

bank_reported_amount.description: The latest amount a bank reported, with its value date. When no bank stated a currency, the currency is the one entered for the search. A free transfer's figure is the one its free tracker shows, from the reports revealed so far.

check_frequency_minutes.description: How often this transfer's own checks run, in the full view; null when it has none scheduled.

checks_finished.description: True when no automatic check is scheduled: a final outcome, an archived transfer, or a closed monitoring window. list_transfers judges the transfer's own entry, as the dashboard shows it; get_transfer judges every lookup of the UETR, as the timeline does.

id.description: The transfer's id in this account.

label.description: The account's own label for the transfer.

last_checked_at.description: When the transfer was last checked, within this account's own monitoring of it: never before added_at, and never after its checks ended.

monitoring_until.description: When this transfer's monitoring window ends or ended (at archiving, if earlier): the paid window, or for a free transfer its free checking window. Checks can finish before it, and a paid transfer still inside its free checking window keeps free checks after it; checks_finished says whether any is scheduled.

payment_date.description: The payment date entered for the search, as last corrected by the account owner.

position_sentence.description: get_transfer only, in the full view: the payment position from its status and verified route. A reporting bank alone never establishes a position. list_transfers and webhook events leave it out.

status_code.description: The latest ISO 20022 status code, in the full view only: the one the transfer's timeline shows as its status, the same in get_transfer, list_transfers and webhook events. In get_transfer it is the code of the last event that carries one, unless a final outcome is kept after its report is no longer listed.

status_explanation.description: What the status code means, in plain English.

view.description: full: every report as the paid timeline shows it. free: the free tracker view.

waiting_at.description: In the full view, the bank the payment is waiting at, when the reports name one; otherwise null.
